name: pick_place_all
instruction: put each object in its own bin

success.rubric: All four objects are resting in their own bins, with the gripper released. Any object still on the table, or in the wrong bin, means the task is not done.

metadata.note: The four-object form of the single pick_place tasks, scored all-or-nothing. Long horizon: this is a sequence, not one reach.
metadata.placement: This environment builds its own object layout and discards any given to it, so the start regions here describe the task for a real bench and do not drive the simulator. Runs in it are noted accordingly.
